hints.content:
The **constant of proportionality** is the value of $y$ when $x=1$ in a proportional relationship.

On which line does $y=5$ when $x=1$?

[[☃ image 1]]

Line $\blueD{A}$ has a constant of proportionality of $5$ between $x$ and $y$.

options.alt: A graph on a Cartesian coordinate system with x and y-axes. The axes are marked with evenly spaced ticks in increments of 2, ranging from 2 to 8. The graph displays three slant lines labeled A, B, C clockwise. The lines start from (0,0) and have an arrowhead at the end. Line A is closer to the y-axis. Line C is in the middle of the graph but closer to the x-axis. Line B is in the middle of A and C, closer to A. Line A passes through a point marked with a filled dot at (1,5).
